decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor still fits the firm's platform-expansion story and earlier visible commitment, so management is inclined to continue despite the weakening ability to blame any underperformance on short-term factors.
As the stated replacement for an older generation, this voltage measurement module is embedded in the firm's public hardware-update path, making withdrawal hard to justify.
The MQTT proxy supports the announced push toward richer software and communication features, and its ecosystem value encourages continued support rather than reversal.
The CAN bus interface remains relevant to automation and embedded customers, but its more specialized role and lower original prominence make it somewhat more exposed than core platform elements.
This carbon dioxide sensor module visibly broadened the measurement portfolio and remains close to the firm's modular sensing direction, which sustains commitment.

The touch panel accessory is comparatively peripheral to the firm's core modules and software, so after several years management has less basis to defend continued commitment if results have disappointed.
